settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.intro: Answers to the questions we hear most about ordering, delivery, payment, returns and warranties at Subhan Fitness.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are delivered within 2–5 working days across Pakistan. Orders placed before 2pm are usually dispatched the same day, and you'll receive tracking as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: Do you offer cash on delivery (COD)?
settings.answer: Yes — cash on delivery is available nationwide. You can also pay securely online by card at checkout.

settings.question: What is your return and exchange policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 7-day easy exchange on unused items in original packaging. See our Returns & Exchange page for full details.

settings.question: Is there a warranty on gym equipment?
settings.answer: Selected machines carry a manufacturer warranty; the period is shown on the product page where applicable.

settings.question: How do I choose the right equipment?
settings.answer: Browse by category, or message us on WhatsApp and our team will recommend the best gear for your goals and space.

settings.question: Do you deliver heavy items like treadmills?
settings.answer: Yes. Large items are shipped with care via our courier partners; timelines for oversized items may vary by city.
